name: PanelHeader
description: A Panel heading with an optional icon, description and trailing actions.
signature: ({ icon, title, description, actions, level, className, children, ...rest }: PanelHeaderProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-aligned controls. Keep to ghost/secondary buttons, tabs or a segmented control.

props.name: description
props.description: Additional content describing the value, state, or consequence.

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon element without an explicit size; the component sizes it through its tokens.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level for the title; panels on a page are normally h2.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
